Lustre metadata client (MDC) request counters per filesystem, read from /proc/fs/lustre/mdc/<obd>/md_stats if present, else the legacy stats file. All MDC OBDs of one filesystem (one per MDT) are summed into one row; every sample, but the per-op keys only in @full rows. Built with --enable-lustre (default on).

Filesystem client LOV name: the /proc/fs/lustre/lov entry minus its -<16 hex superblock> suffix, e.g. scratch-clilov. Each MDC OBD (e.g. scratch-MDT0000-mdc-ffff8881a2b3c400) maps here by the same superblock suffix. Not a mount path.

Metadata lock cancel requests sent to the MDS, from mdc line ldlm_cancel sample count. Counter: difference between samples / elapsed seconds = ops/s. Summed over all MDCs of the filesystem; @full rows only.

Metadata file close requests sent to the MDS, from mdc line close (md_stats) or mds_close (legacy stats) sample count. Counter: difference between samples / elapsed seconds = ops/s. Summed over all MDCs of the filesystem; @full rows only.

Metadata getattr requests sent to the MDS, from mdc line getattr (md_stats) or mds_getattr (legacy stats) sample count. Counter: difference between samples / elapsed seconds = ops/s. Summed over all MDCs of the filesystem; @full rows only.

Metadata getattr-with-lock requests sent to the MDS, from mdc line intent_getattr_async (md_stats) or mds_getattr_lock (legacy stats) sample count. Counter: difference between samples / elapsed seconds = ops/s. Summed over all MDCs of the filesystem; @full rows only.

Metadata getxattr requests sent to the MDS, from mdc line getxattr (md_stats) or mds_getxattr (legacy stats) sample count. Counter: difference between samples / elapsed seconds = ops/s. Summed over all MDCs of the filesystem; @full rows only.

Metadata directory page reads sent to the MDS, from mdc line read_page (md_stats) or mds_readpage (legacy stats) sample count. Counter: difference between samples / elapsed seconds = ops/s. Summed over all MDCs of the filesystem; @full rows only.

Metadata statfs requests sent to the MDS, from mdc line mds_statfs (legacy stats only; md_stats has no such name) sample count. Counter: difference between samples / elapsed seconds = ops/s. Summed over all MDCs of the filesystem; @full rows only.

Metadata fsync requests sent to the MDS, from mdc line fsync (md_stats) or mds_sync (legacy stats) sample count. Counter: difference between samples / elapsed seconds = ops/s. Summed over all MDCs of the filesystem; @full rows only.

MDC request count: req_waittime sample count when that line exists, plus counts of every line not mapped to another key (e.g. req_active, other opcodes), so not a pure RPC count. Summed over all MDCs of the filesystem. Counter: difference between samples / elapsed seconds = req/s.

Total MDC request wait time in microseconds, from mdc req_waittime line sum field. md_stats normally has no req_waittime, so this stays 0 when md_stats is read. Summed over all MDCs. Counter: difference between samples / elapsed seconds = us waited per second.

Lustre object storage client (OSC) RPC and byte counters per filesystem, read from /proc/fs/lustre/osc/<obd>/osc_stats if present, else stats. All OSC OBDs of one filesystem (one per OST) are summed into one row, emitted every sample. Built with --enable-lustre (default on).

Filesystem client LOV name: the /proc/fs/lustre/lov entry minus its -<16 hex superblock> suffix, e.g. scratch-clilov. Each OSC OBD (e.g. scratch-OST0004-osc-ffff8881a2b3c400) maps here by the same superblock suffix. Not a mount path.

Bytes read from OSTs, from osc stats lines read_bytes plus lockless_read_bytes sum field (count if no sum). Summed over all OSCs of the filesystem. Counter: difference between samples / elapsed seconds = bytes/s.

Bytes written to OSTs, from osc stats lines write_bytes plus lockless_write_bytes sum field (count if no sum). Summed over all OSCs of the filesystem. Counter: difference between samples / elapsed seconds = bytes/s.
Count of object destroy RPCs to OSTs, from osc stats line ost_destroy sample count. Summed over all OSCs of the filesystem. Counter: difference between samples / elapsed seconds = RPCs/s.
Count of punch (truncate/hole) RPCs to OSTs, from osc stats line ost_punch sample count. Summed over all OSCs of the filesystem. Counter: difference between samples / elapsed seconds = RPCs/s.
Count of bulk read RPCs to OSTs, from osc stats line ost_read sample count. Summed over all OSCs of the filesystem. Counter: difference between samples / elapsed seconds = RPCs/s.
Count of setattr RPCs to OSTs, from osc stats line ost_setattr sample count. Summed over all OSCs of the filesystem. Counter: difference between samples / elapsed seconds = RPCs/s.
Count of statfs RPCs to OSTs, from osc stats line ost_statfs sample count. Summed over all OSCs of the filesystem. Counter: difference between samples / elapsed seconds = RPCs/s.
Count of bulk write RPCs to OSTs, from osc stats line ost_write sample count. Summed over all OSCs of the filesystem. Counter: difference between samples / elapsed seconds = RPCs/s.

OSC request count: req_waittime sample count plus counts of every line not mapped to another key (e.g. req_active, ldlm_cancel, obd_ping), so not a pure RPC count. Summed over all OSCs of the filesystem. Counter: difference between samples / elapsed seconds = req/s.

Total OSC request wait time in microseconds, from osc req_waittime line sum field. Summed over all OSCs of the filesystem. Counter: difference between samples / elapsed seconds = us waited per second. reqs also counts non-RPC lines, so wait/reqs underestimates mean latency.

Per-GPU NVIDIA telemetry (build flag --enable-gpu). Preferred source is NVML plus GPM (libnvidia-ml dlopen at runtime, GPM-capable GPUs, Hopper and newer); otherwise, or after an NVML failure mid-run, DCGM fields via dlopen of libdcgm with a watch ladder full-prof, split-prof-no-dfma, core-prof, basic-nonprof. GPM/DCGM PROF values cover the collect interval.
GPU index 0..N-1 as a decimal string, e.g. 0 for the first GPU; NVML device index, and on the DCGM path the DCGM GPU id is assumed equal to the NVML index (true on GB200 and GH200).

GPU utilization in %: fraction of recent time one or more kernels ran. NVML nvmlDeviceGetUtilizationRates .gpu, or DCGM field 203 DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL. Gauge, driver's own recent averaging window. Coarse busy signal; use sm_active for how much of the GPU was used.

Memory utilization in %: fraction of recent time device memory was being read or written. NVML nvmlDeviceGetUtilizationRates .memory, or DCGM field 204 DCGM_FI_DEV_MEM_COPY_UTIL. Gauge. Also the only input of the gpu_mem_bw_bytes_rate estimate.
Total GPU framebuffer memory in MiB (labelled MB). NVML nvmlDeviceGetMemoryInfo total / 1048576, or DCGM field 250 DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_TOTAL. Gauge, constant per device.
Used GPU framebuffer memory in MiB (labelled MB), all processes on the GPU. NVML nvmlDeviceGetMemoryInfo used / 1048576, or DCGM field 252 DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED. Instantaneous gauge.
Free GPU framebuffer memory in MiB (labelled MB). NVML nvmlDeviceGetMemoryInfo free / 1048576, or DCGM field 251 DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_FREE. Instantaneous gauge.

Current SM clock in MHz. NVML nvmlDeviceGetClockInfo(NVML_CLOCK_SM), or DCGM field 100 DCGM_FI_DEV_SM_CLOCK. Instantaneous gauge. Used by the gpu_flops_rate estimate; drops below boost when clocks_event_reasons shows throttling.

GPU power draw in W, rounded to whole watts. NVML nvmlDeviceGetPowerUsage (mW / 1000), or DCGM field 155 DCGM_FI_DEV_POWER_USAGE. Gauge as reported by the driver. Per-GPU only; for GH200 module and Grace socket power see host_power_socket.
GPU core temperature in C. NVML nvmlDeviceGetTemperature(NVML_TEMPERATURE_GPU), or DCGM field 150 DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP. Instantaneous gauge. NOT_PRESENT when the NVML library lacks the call.

Fraction of cycles the FP64 (double precision, non-tensor) pipe was active. Ratio x 100 rounded to integer % (0-100), averaged over the collect interval. NVML GPM NVML_GPM_METRIC_FP64_UTIL (11), or DCGM field 1006 DCGM_FI_PROF_PIPE_FP64_ACTIVE (DCGM profiling field: needs the profiling module and a PROF watch profile, else NOT_PRESENT). Input to gpu_flops.

Fraction of cycles an SM had at least one warp assigned, averaged over all SMs. Ratio x 100 rounded to integer % (0-100), averaged over the collect interval. NVML GPM NVML_GPM_METRIC_SM_UTIL (2), or DCGM field 1002 DCGM_FI_PROF_SM_ACTIVE (DCGM profiling field: needs the profiling module and a PROF watch profile, else NOT_PRESENT).

Resident warps on an SM as a fraction of the theoretical maximum, averaged over SMs. Ratio x 100 rounded to integer % (0-100), averaged over the collect interval. NVML GPM NVML_GPM_METRIC_SM_OCCUPANCY (3), or DCGM field 1003 DCGM_FI_PROF_SM_OCCUPANCY (DCGM profiling field: needs the profiling module and a PROF watch profile, else NOT_PRESENT).

Fraction of cycles the FP32 (non-tensor) pipe was active. Ratio x 100 rounded to integer % (0-100), averaged over the collect interval. NVML GPM NVML_GPM_METRIC_FP32_UTIL (12), or DCGM field 1007 DCGM_FI_PROF_PIPE_FP32_ACTIVE (DCGM profiling field: needs the profiling module and a PROF watch profile, else NOT_PRESENT). Input to gpu_flops.

Fraction of cycles the FP16 (non-tensor) pipe was active. Ratio x 100 rounded to integer % (0-100), averaged over the collect interval. NVML GPM NVML_GPM_METRIC_FP16_UTIL (13), or DCGM field 1008 DCGM_FI_PROF_PIPE_FP16_ACTIVE (DCGM profiling field: needs the profiling module and a PROF watch profile, else NOT_PRESENT). Input to gpu_flops.

Fraction of cycles any tensor pipe was active. Ratio x 100 rounded to integer % (0-100), averaged over the collect interval. NVML GPM NVML_GPM_METRIC_ANY_TENSOR_UTIL (5), or DCGM field 1004 DCGM_FI_PROF_PIPE_TENSOR_ACTIVE (DCGM profiling field: needs the profiling module and a PROF watch profile, else NOT_PRESENT). Not used by gpu_flops.

Tensor IMMA (integer / low-precision MMA) pipe duty cycle in % (0-100), averaged over the collect interval. NVML GPM IMMA_TENSOR_UTIL (9) or DCGM PROF field 1013 (full-prof or split-prof-no-dfma watch only). FP8-adjacent signal only, not FP8 FLOPs; excluded from gpu_flops.

Tensor HMMA pipe duty cycle in % (0-100) over the collect interval: FP16/BF16/TF32/FP8 matrix math. NVML GPM HMMA_TENSOR_UTIL (7) or DCGM PROF field 1014 (full-prof or split-prof-no-dfma watch). Counted in gpu_flops at the dense FP16 tensor per-SM peak.

DFMA pipe duty cycle in % (0-100) over the collect interval: the FP64 FMA pipe (equals fp64_active on Hopper and Blackwell), not FP64 tensor. NVML GPM DFMA_TENSOR_UTIL (6) or DCGM PROF field 1015 (full-prof only; NOT_PRESENT on A100 / DCGM 3.1). Excluded from gpu_flops.

Tensor DMMA (FP64 tensor MMA) pipe duty cycle in % (0-100) over the collect interval. NVML GPM DMMA_TENSOR_UTIL (8) only: DCGM has no DMMA field, so NOT_PRESENT on the DCGM path. Counted in gpu_flops at the FP64 tensor per-SM peak.

Fraction of cycles the integer pipe was active, in % (0-100), averaged over the collect interval. NVML GPM INTEGER_UTIL (4) or DCGM PROF field 1016 DCGM_FI_PROF_PIPE_INT_ACTIVE (full-prof watch only; NOT_PRESENT on A100 / DCGM 3.1). Excluded from gpu_flops.

Device memory (HBM/GDDR) bandwidth utilization in % (0-100) over the collect interval. NVML GPM DRAM_BW_UTIL (10, % of theoretical peak bandwidth) or DCGM PROF field 1005 DCGM_FI_PROF_DRAM_ACTIVE (fraction of cycles memory interface active). Better memory-bound signal than gpu_mem_util.

PCIe bytes transmitted by the GPU in bytes, cumulative counter (E; take deltas). Monitor-integrated: each collect multiplies the interval rate by elapsed time and adds it. Rate from NVML GPM PCIE_TX_PER_SEC (20) (MiB/s x 1048576) or DCGM 1009 DCGM_FI_PROF_PCIE_TX_BYTES (profiling field, bytes/s). Starts at 0 at daemon start; approximate.

PCIe bytes received by the GPU in bytes, cumulative counter (E; take deltas). Monitor-integrated: each collect multiplies the interval rate by elapsed time and adds it. Rate from NVML GPM PCIE_RX_PER_SEC (21) (MiB/s x 1048576) or DCGM 1010 DCGM_FI_PROF_PCIE_RX_BYTES (profiling field, bytes/s). Starts at 0 at daemon start; approximate.

NVLink bytes transmitted, all links in bytes, cumulative counter (E; take deltas). Monitor-integrated: each collect multiplies the interval rate by elapsed time and adds it. Rate from NVML GPM NVLINK_TOTAL_TX_PER_SEC (61) (MiB/s x 1048576) or DCGM 1011 DCGM_FI_PROF_NVLINK_TX_BYTES (profiling field, bytes/s). Starts at 0 at daemon start; approximate.

NVLink bytes received, all links in bytes, cumulative counter (E; take deltas). Monitor-integrated: each collect multiplies the interval rate by elapsed time and adds it. Rate from NVML GPM NVLINK_TOTAL_RX_PER_SEC (60) (MiB/s x 1048576) or DCGM 1012 DCGM_FI_PROF_NVLINK_RX_BYTES (profiling field, bytes/s). Starts at 0 at daemon start; approximate.

Count of PCIe link-level packet replays (retransmissions after link errors), as reported by the driver. NVML nvmlDeviceGetPcieReplayCounter or DCGM field 202 DCGM_FI_DEV_PCIE_REPLAY_COUNTER. Cumulative counter (E); a rising delta indicates PCIe link trouble.

Bitmask (not a number to average) of current reasons the GPU clocks are reduced, e.g. idle, power cap, thermal slowdown. NVML nvmlDeviceGetCurrentClocksEventReasons (older drivers: ...ThrottleReasons, same bits) or DCGM field 112. Decode with nvmlClocksEventReason bit definitions. Instantaneous gauge.

ESTIMATED floating-point rate in FLOP/s: sum over fp64, fp32, fp16, tensor HMMA and DMMA pipes of duty cycle x per-SM peak for the compute capability x SM count x SM clock (nvidia_gpu_estimate.c). Gauge for the collect interval. Only CC 8.0, 9.0, 10.0, 12.0 known; else NOT_PRESENT. IMMA, DFMA, integer excluded.
ESTIMATED memory bandwidth in B/s = gpu_mem_util / 100 x a fixed 1e12 B/s placeholder peak (not the GPU's real peak). Gauge. Rough indicator only; prefer gpu_dram_active for memory-bound analysis.

ESTIMATED cumulative floating-point operations: gpu_flops_rate integrated over each collect interval by the monitor. Counter (E, 64-bit wrap); delta / seconds = average FLOP/s. Zero from daemon start; not advanced on intervals whose inputs were unreadable. Same caveats as gpu_flops_rate.

ESTIMATED cumulative memory read bytes: half of gpu_mem_total_bytes (fixed 50/50 split, no real read/write measurement). Counter (E). Derived from gpu_mem_util x fixed 1e12 B/s placeholder peak; rough only.

ESTIMATED cumulative memory write bytes: the other half of gpu_mem_total_bytes (fixed 50/50 split, no real read/write measurement). Counter (E). Derived from gpu_mem_util x fixed 1e12 B/s placeholder peak; rough only.

ESTIMATED cumulative memory traffic in bytes: gpu_mem_bw_bytes_rate (gpu_mem_util / 100 x fixed 1e12 B/s) integrated over each collect interval. Counter (E, 64-bit wrap). Rough indicator, not a measured byte count.

Cumulative PCIe TX+RX plus NVLink TX+RX bytes (sum of the four link counters' increments), in bytes. Counter (E). Only advances on intervals where all four link rates were read. Link I/O only, not HBM/DRAM traffic. Monitor-integrated from GPM or DCGM PROF rates.
Number of NVIDIA GPUs the monitor sees on this node (NVML device count on the NVML path, DCGM-visible count on the DCGM path); same value on every device row. Gauge. Slow key: only in @full rows.
